kapak.alt: The air-bone gap may look smaller

youtube.baslik: How does a noisy room change the air-bone gap? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Ambient noise can show up on the audiogram: a person with normal hearing may have unexpectedly poor low-frequency thresholds. Bone conduction is measured with the ears uncovered, so it is affected more, which can make the air-bone gap look smaller than it is. If low-frequency thresholds improve clearly with insert earphones, low-pitched noise in the room may be exceeding the limit.
